summary.intent: Switch the staging environment's TEE worker from Phala's hosted CVM service to a locally-hosted simulator to reduce staging hosting costs.
summary.outcome: A chore branch was created with edits to docker-compose.staging.yml and deploy-staging.yml; the changes were committed but the transcript ends before the PR is created.

repo: Staging TEE worker runs on Phala CVM with hardware-backed dstack SDK; switching to simulator mode uses HKDF from a fixed seed, producing different epoch keys that break existing IPNS key decryption — staging users must re-register after the switch.
TEE worker URL is injected as TEE_WORKER_URL env var and was previously pointing at an external Phala URL; in the new setup it points at http://tee-worker:3001 on the internal Docker network.
The deploy-staging workflow contains a separate deploy-tee-phala job that needed to be removed when moving to the local simulator.
The repo is at github.com/FSM1/cipher-box; a recent tag staging-20260526-release-1 was cut the day before this session.

code.finding: Contains a deploy-tee-phala job that provisions the Phala CVM; this was removed as part of switching to local simulator.
A new tee-worker service running in simulator mode was added to this file, placed on the internal network only.
